name: Azukari Stays
description: Azukari Stays is a calm, documentary-style WordPress theme designed for holiday-let management companies and property caretakers who represent absentee owners. Built with clean typography, a five-stage service flow, and an interactive floor plan, it emphasizes operational transparency from initial onboarding through monthly owner payouts. It provides a structured, responsive layout with dedicated sections for fee schedules, home portfolios, and owner consultations.
